svg.title: Chapter I · THE WALL
svg.desc: Comic panel, chapter I · THE WALL. Pixel art: a towering wall of ice at night with torches along the top, arrows stuck in the ice and a dark pine forest at its foot. Prompt-injection robustness study. 600 attacked runs, none led to a harmful action. Task success 96.5–100%. Stack: LangGraph, Qwen via Groq, Sentinel-1/2, ERA5.
